messages:
cust_ops_john: Hey team — customer hit a hard break after we pinned their model. Their embeddings used to be 1024-length, now responses are 256 and their search index fails with shape mismatch. Happening since the pinned variant went live ~2h ago. urgent pls.

sara_support: omg, thanks for flagging. do you have the customer id and a minimal request that reproduces? error text? :eyes:

cust_ops_john: customer_id=cust-420. error from their indexer: "AssertionError: expected vector length 1024 but got 256". They use our embeddings endpoint /v1/embeddings with model alias pinned to pinned:open-embed-xl:stable (they said). Sample request: ```POST /v1/embeddings {
  "model": "pinned:open-embed-xl:stable",
  "input": ["hello world"]
}``` Response header x-model-resolved: open-embed-small-v2.

mike_eng: thanks. can you paste full response headers/metadata? if x-model-resolved is open-embed-small-v2 then alias substitution likely happened. infra-bot: deploy-event: variant-freeze apply 1718203000 by rollout-bot.

julia_ml: quick note: open-embed-xl -> 1024, open-embed-small -> 256. If their alias resolved to small that explains vector width. But why would a pinned alias resolve? pinned:* should lock exact variant.
sara_support: customer insists they pinned. cust_ops_john — can you confirm the pin request body they used? any chance they used a model alias that maps to pinned: but without a version?
cust_ops_john: they used the console pin UI; screenshot attached in original ticket (screenshot: pin confirmation showing alias pinned:open-embed-xl). I asked for the API pin record but customer is on a tight outage window.
mike_eng: (quick triage) two hypotheses: 1) UI showed their requested target but backend recorded a different variant id (race/rollback), 2) our routing layer applied fallback to a compatible embedding model under overload and returned small variant while still honoring a pinned entry in control plane. checking routing logs now.

infra-bot: routing-log: request=1718204257 token=cust-420 route=embed-robin shard=eu-west-1 resolved_model=open-embed-small-v2 fallback_reason=capacity-shortage
julia_ml: that fallback_reason is worrying. Fallback should not occur for pinned customers. There might be a policy bug where pinned reserve wasn't applied to the embed pool.
sara_support: ok escalation path: mike can you confirm whether the RBAC/pin table shows the correct mapping for cust-420? If pin absent, we escalate to infra; if present, we escalate to serving/runtime owners.
mike_eng: I pulled the pin table: record exists -> pinned:open-embed-xl@2026-03-17T09:12:44Z target_model_id=open-embed-xl-v3. But serving logs show x-model-resolved=open-embed-small-v2. Looking into cache TTL for alias->variant mapping.
mike_eng: suspicious log: alias-resolver cache miss at 1718203001 then alias fallback to default mapping at 1718203002. There's a race right after the variant freeze deploy. pinned write happened during deploy window; our alias resolver could have returned pre-freeze mapping.
julia_ml: so sequence: deploy/variant-freeze -> alias mapping updated -> pinned write -> alias resolver cache inconsistency -> some requests routed to fallback small. That explains intermittent/partial 256 vectors.
cust_ops_john: customer seeing 30% of requests return 256 vectors; index step throws error and fails batch. They're asking for rollback or urgent mitigation.
sara_support: immediate mitigation options: 1) force a redeploy of pin mapping for cust-420 (re-apply pin entry) — quick fix, 2) instruct their indexer to accept variable vector sizes (not ideal), 3) temporary rollback of variant freeze (heavy). Which is fastest?
mike_eng: re-applying the pin mapping should update alias cache and is low-risk. I'll patch alias-resolver to honor pinned entries first and purge cache for cust-420. Doing it now.

infra-bot: action: alias-cache-purge cust-420 triggered by mike_eng at 1718207602
mike_eng: cache purge done. routing-log (post-purge): request=1718207689 resolved_model=open-embed-xl-v3 fallback_reason=none
julia_ml: ran a quick regression: sample embeddings now 1024. Looks good.
cust_ops_john: customer confirmed new requests are 1024 and index ingests successfully. they want RCA and request we keep them pinned until we verify no further churn.
sara_support: note for ticket: root cause = alias-resolver cache race during variant freeze which allowed fallback routing to small variant despite a pin record. mitigation = re-apply pin mapping + cache purge. next steps = eng to add guard so pinned customers cannot be subject to fallback, and ops to add an automated cache invalidation when pins are created during deployments.
mike_eng: I'll open a follow-up PR for alias-resolver to check the pin table before falling back, and add integration test that simulates writes during deploy. ETA for PR: today EOD.
julia_ml: I'll add a perf test to make sure pinned reservations are respected under load, and alert if embedding width inconsistent across 5xx requests.
sara_support: thanks all. marking customer ticket as resolved pending monitoring for 1h. :white_check_mark:
